spec: specs/policy-issuance_spec.md specs/endorsement_spec.md — PolicyForge Sprint 3 (branch feat/issuance-endorsement, cut from dev @ 246e7cb). Scope: policy issuance with unique policy numbers and ACTIVE status (AC-05.1–05.4), immutable endorsements with atomic version + transition writes and sum-insured re-rating (AC-06.1–06.7), the policy state machine with InvalidPolicyStateException (AC-10.1–10.4), plus quote ownership (AC-01.12, AC-01.13, AC-03.9 — spec commit 819a246); frontend: My Policies list, Policy Detail (versions, endorsements, status history) and Endorse page with Playwright journeys (desktop + mobile) and committed visual snapshots. Constraints: root CLAUDE.md non-negotiables and folder CLAUDE.md files, incl. web/CLAUDE.md rules KD-007..KD-010 (JSON-only consumes, allow-list responses, explicit public matchers, fixed problem detail, default-deny body limit on the routed path); money BigDecimal and endorsement adjustment must equal premium_check.py oracle (AC-06.2 = 1330.85); append-only policy versions/endorsements/transitions; every test named AC-NN.M. Commits: generators commit locally on feat/issuance-endorsement only, TDD order (`test(red)` before `feat(green)`), explicit paths, never push (same policy as Sprint 2). Hard rule KD-014: run long commands (mvnw verify, npm test, Playwright webServer) in the FOREGROUND, never background-and-wait. Environment: prefix Maven with `export JAVA_HOME="/c/Program Files/Eclipse Adoptium/jdk-21.0.12.101-hotspot"; export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"`. Use project agents where they fit (test-engineer for red, endorsement-agent, policy-state-machine-generator skill, ui-designer; evaluator uses Playwright MCP).
